accessRequired: Meeting content access must be verified.
emptyDescription: No authoritative version is available yet. Eligible regeneration can create a reviewable candidate.
versionsDescription: Generated and human-reviewed versions will appear here.
heading: Meeting summary
description: Review the authoritative current version separately from AI candidates and human edits.
editConflict: This summary changed while you were editing.
latestUnverified: The latest version has not been verified. Retry before saving.
draftRetained: Your pending changes remain in the editor. Review the latest version before establishing a new baseline.
activationConflict: The current summary changed before activation. Review the refreshed current version and explicitly select Activate again.
historyDescription: Historical versions are read-only until an eligible fresh version is explicitly activated.
admittedUnavailable: Regeneration was admitted, but its current status is unavailable. Refresh the exact job without requesting generation again.
admittedTracking: Regeneration was admitted. Tracking the exact job independently of the processing list.
alreadyCurrent: Summary is already up to date
editPermissionLost: Your summary editing permission is no longer available.
activated: Selected summary version is now current
refreshBeforeRetry: Refresh the meeting authorization and processing state before trying again.
followJob: Follow the admitted job status and review any resulting version.
workerUnavailable: Summary generation is currently unavailable because the worker is not ready.
editUnauthorized: Summary editing is no longer authorized.
reviewBeforeSave: Review the current summary before saving.
invalidLength: Summary content must be between 1 and 20,000 characters.
activationUnauthorized: Summary activation is no longer authorized.
reviewBeforeActivate: Review the current summary before activating a version.
freshOnly: Only a fresh historical version can be activated.
regenerationUnauthorized: Summary regeneration is no longer authorized.
requiresOwner: Summary regeneration requires the meeting processing owner.
